thread:
iris: Small but painful onboarding snafu today. Two copy/paste bugs in the README + quickstart: (1) the example package name in the JS install command is wrong, and (2) the env var shown doesn't match what the examples and SDK expect.
iris: README currently has `npm install @redwood/inference` but our published package is `redwood-inference-sdk` (people hit 404/npm not found).
iris: Also the README shows `REDWOOD_API` in a few places while the sample app and SDK read `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. New hires are copying README -> creating creds with the wrong env var and then puzzling why examples print auth errors.
noah: Oof. That explains the 20-minute onboarding stall I observed. Any other quirks?
iris: Yep: the docs include a fenced code block with bash-only line continuations which renders fine in mkdocs but when copied into PowerShell it breaks. And one of the example markdown blocks had an extra leading space before the triple-backticks so it didn't render, which confused the lab students. Small markdown formatting thing but annoying.
sam: Thanks for the detailed repro. I'll update the README to: (A) use the correct npm package `redwood-inference-sdk`, (B) canonicalize to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` everywhere, (C) show a portable single-line curl plus an explicit PowerShell Invoke-RestMethod example, and (D) fix the fenced code block indentation.
sam: I'll also add a short note in the README: "Confirm package: npm view redwood-inference-sdk" and a tiny troubleshooting section "If you see 404 on npm install, check your spelling and run `npm cache clean --force`".
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/980  changes: fix npm package name, normalize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY, add PowerShell example, fix code fence rendering.
rhea: Can we add a pre-commit docs lint that searches for deprecated env var names (REDWOOD_API, REDWOOD_KEY, REDWOOD_TOKEN) so this doesn't slip back in? Also a tiny smoke script that verifies the example app reads process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY (no network calls) would be nice.
sam: Good call. I'll add a docs pre-commit hook (simple grep) and drop docs/examples/verify-env.js which exits non-zero if canonical var not present in examples. I'll also add a CI docs:smoke job to run the script.
iris: Awesome. One extra ask: update the onboarding lab doc to explicitly call out the correct npm package and env var and include the PowerShell steps for Windows users. New hires keep assuming the devcontainer auto-injects secrets.
sam: Will do. Filing a follow-up sweeping issue to validate package names and env vars across language samples after this PR merges.
docs-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/322 (sweep: package-name & env var parity across docs).
iris: Thanks everyone  please ping me when PR merges and I'll re-run the lab. :thumbsup:
